question: Can contradiction-triggered source-observation auditing reduce false confident held-out predictions under causal-family shift and corrupted labels while retaining in-family coverage, under the same 32 fabricated action-consequence observations?
scope: New source-free simulated worlds only. No CKAD09/12 original replay or A2 score-based tuning. No original-source effects or original first-use, native acceptance, controller, runner, scheduler, PR or merge. Reuse unchanged A2 generator and native 7-bit degree2 readout.

worlds.in_family: Synthetic seed300..331, 32 independently generated degree2 private Boolean worlds
worlds.shift: Synthetic seed400..431, 32 private degree3 Boolean worlds; learner NOT told world class
worlds.corrupt: Same seed300..331 but labels of first24 observations SHA-permuted only, eight audit effects genuine; separate negative experiment, NOT independent worlds
worlds.input: Seven binary coordinates, six properties and action; A2 supplied monomial truth construction, policy receives only witnessed public effects
worlds.held: Same A2 SHA256-frozen 64 of 128 possible input masks; withheld from policy, immutable; no truth until predictions sealed
worlds.budget: Per scenario and audit arm 8 initial +16 FIT +8 fresh AUDIT effects; target audit and full32 baseline reuse exactly same32 effects, random audit gets own matching8 effects; 64 simulated source effects per scenario total

rules.shared_fit: A2 active input-only order: first8 common initial and first16 selected =24. Train degree2; lock checkpoint before selecting audit. Same24 observed outcomes for targeted and random audits.
rules.target_probe: Choose eight unobserved masks from remaining40. Favor masks predicted IDENTIFIED by frozen24fit model; then degree3 generic input-only feature rank gain, balanced action novelty and SHA tie. No hidden truth or source outcomes to choose. Degree3 monitor is supplied bias, NOT a family label.
rules.random_probe: Eight distinct remaining masks sorted by SHA256('nci-mismatch-a3:random:'+seed+':'+mask), no outcome dependence.
rules.gate: Candidate24 must exist. Require at least four audit probes with identified prediction and zero wrong outcomes; otherwise deny all held readouts. After gate refit ordinary native degree2 on all32 witnessed effects; refusal/inconsistency denies.
rules.baseline: On same targeted32 effects train unvalidated native degree2; report all held predictions including wrong.
rules.random_audit: Identical24 fit, eight random audit effects, same four-confirmations-and-zero-contradiction gate and refit on its32 effects.
rules.controls: Independent existing A2 symbolic solver exactly matches native on all128 masks for full32 baseline and enabled target/random outputs. Fully trained CART on targeted32; report separate compute costs.
rules.negative: SHIFT and CORRUPT evaluated separately. Held truth, original source and true family never pass to detector.

frozen_thresholds.primary: SHIFT target wrong/confident reduces >=90% vs unvalidated baseline AND wrong among targeted answered <=1% AND wrong among all targeted held <=1%
frozen_thresholds.retention: IN_FAMILY targeted >=75% correct held coverage with zero wrong, and no >10pp loss of correct coverage vs unvalidated baseline
frozen_thresholds.comparison: Target <= random-audit wrong answers; ties reported.
frozen_thresholds.negative: CORRUPT targeted wrong among confident <=1% and explicit false admissions; negative failure => DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO
frozen_thresholds.engineering: Exact32-effect budget per audit arm, all held outcomes sealed until predictions ready, cold checkpoint equality, symbolic parity, source-seed pins and negatives, Linux/Windows stable replication, full final root+NKR05/G29
frozen_thresholds.science: scientific_pass=false regardless, synthetic supplied degree2/3 grammar and equivalent symbolic

sampling: One frozen 32+32 paired seed collection, no post-result changes, null/negative retained
